vulnerableUninitializedLogic.explanation: CRITICAL: Implementation logic contract exposes callable initialize() without constructor locking (_disableInitializers()). An attacker can front-run initialization, become owner, and execute selfdestruct or malicious delegatecall to destroy all connected proxies.

protectedLockedLogic.explanation: Implementation logic contract properly locks uninitialized state via _disableInitializers() in constructor. Front-running initialization attack vector is mathematically neutralized.
